title: Backups & restore
subtitle: A backup is saved automatically when a world is archived after long inactivity. You can use these backups to restore the world — the server must be stopped first.
not_yours_body: Only the owner or an admin can view and restore this server's backups.
latest_note: Default restore target. You can also select and restore an older backup from the history below.
history_note: Historical backups can be used for restore before they expire. They are automatically cleaned up when they expire.
empty_hint: A backup is saved only when a world is archived after long inactivity.
restore_confirm: Restoring a backup will stop the server (all online players will be disconnected) and completely overwrite the current world with this backup. This operation is irreversible. Do you want to continue?
restore_started: Restore started — the world is being rebuilt from this backup. Wake the server once it finishes to see the restored world.
stop_timeout: The server did not stop in time. Close this window and try again shortly.
expired_cannot_restore: This backup has expired and can no longer be restored.
